text:
maya: Heads up — LimeCrest (dedicated) opened a support ticket: p99 for /v1/generate jumped from ~180ms to ~640ms starting ~2026-03-16T18:10Z. Customer saw it on a steady 90qps workload. Can eng-runtime take a look?

jonathan: thanks, paging in. Do we have a sample trace or pprof from their instance?

support-bot: LimeCrest ticket #LC-4721; attached logs and 10s heatmap. Link: https://redwood.support/LC-4721 (internal)

maya: pasted the 1-min percentiles they sent: ```p50 120ms, p90 210ms, p95 290ms, p99 640ms, p999 950ms```

lee: quick checks — was there a rollout yesterday to kernel-selector or batching heuristics? I flipped a small kernel-selector tweak in canary at 17:50Z but it shouldn't hit dedicated until next rollout window.

samira: LimeCrest is pinned to model rwd-v2-fp16-q4 (pinned on 2026-02-22). No model change in their config. They are on Dedicated pool dc-eu-3 (gpu pool id dp-09).

jonathan: ok, schedule: I want someone to run a perf reproduction against a mirror of dc-eu-3 with their workload (90qps, seq_len=512, typical prompt mix). If we can reproduce we can profile. @lee can you spawn a small job?

lee: spawning now — firing k8s job perf-runner: ```./perf-runner --target dc-eu-3 --qps 90 --seq 512 --duration 10m --model rwd-v2-fp16-q4``` ETA ~6m to warm.

ops-bot: perf-runner job pr-893 created. Pod: perf-runner-zz7.

maya: also ask infra to check for noisy neighbors or GPU memory pressure around 18:00Z on dp-09. Last time we saw similar p99 spikes they were KV cache thrash + a tiny batching bug under high concurrency.

samira: pinged infra (ticket INF-7522) — they’ll check utilization and host migrations.

lee: repro job logs (first 2 mins): ```[00:01] avg_latency 190ms p99 210ms; [00:03] avg 200ms p99 220ms; [00:06] p99 climbs to 610ms; logs show repeated evictions in kvcache: "kv_cache: miss -> load backend"```

jonathan: that kvcache eviction pattern matters. Any recent change to prefix caching or idle eviction thresholds?

lee: yes — I merged PR #4821 last week that reduced kvcache memory cap slightly to control OOM risk on longctx models. Might be too aggressive.

maya: if we revert that change in a canary for dp-09 we can test. But need to coordinate with infra for memory headroom.

samira: confirmed LimeCrest isn't using longctx variant; still, kvcache eviction could affect many short requests if entries are churned.

jonathan: alternate hypothesis: kernel-selector falling back to a slower matmul kernel under certain sequence-length combos, creating intermittent slow tails. We should capture kernel selection metrics during repro. @lee add DEBUG kernel-selector sampling on perf-runner.

lee: done — enabling env REDWOOD_KSEL_DEBUG=1 on the job and re-running from warm state. Re-run started.

ops-bot: perf-runner job pr-894 created (with KSEL debug).

lee: new run results (summary): p99 650ms during minute 7; KSEL logs show fallback path to generic_gemm for ~12% of calls when seq>384 and batch size jittered. Also kvcache evictions still present.

samira: so two signals: kvcache thrash + kernel fallback during certain batch/seq patterns. Both could multiply.

maya: next steps: 1) temporarily increase kvcache cap for dp-09 to stop evictions (config patch), 2) force preferred kernel build for that model/seq combo in canary, 3) re-run perf. Who can own 1 and 2?

lee: I can do (1) — pushing config patch to dp-09 now: `kv_cache.max_bytes += 40%` (canary). Will monitor OOM.

jonathan: I can change kernel selector override in the runtime on canary nodes to prefer fast_gemm for rwd-v2-fp16-q4 when seq>=384. I'll coordinate a canary rollout window.

ops-bot: config patch deployed to dp-09-canary pool. Monitoring for 15m.

lee: after kvcap bump p99 dropped to ~240ms during a 10m window. Still sporadic spikes to ~420ms when fallback happens.

samira: infra report back: no host migrations, GPU util for dp-09 steady ~63%. Memory headroom ok after kvcap bump.

jonathan: after kernel-override canary applied to 10% of nodes, perf-run shows p99 ~220ms stable, p999 rare ~460ms. Looks like combination fix works.

maya: great — propose rolling the fixes to dp-09 full pool and notify LimeCrest before we change customer-facing config. Samira, can you draft the customer message with timeline and mitigation?

samira: drafting now. Will include RCA: aggressive kvcache cap reduction + kernel-selector fallback under certain seq/batch jitter -> multiplied tail latency. Mitigation: increased kvcache cap + selector override; full rollout 30m after canary if stable.

maya: thanks. @support-bot please update ticket LC-4721 with status and ETA.

support-bot: Ticket LC-4721 updated: mitigation deployed to canary; full rollout planned in 30m pending stability checks. Message queued to customer. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: follow-up action: revert PR #4821 and put a safety guard to adapt kvcache cap by observed churn rates (not a static hard cap). I'll open follow-up PR and tag runtime/kvcache.

maya: owner matrix: jonathan (kernel selector follow-up), lee (kvcache config + revert PR), samira (customer comms), infra on standby. If any regression during full rollout ping #oncall immediately.

lee: will keep an eye for 1h. thanks team. :thumbsup:
